title: Statistical model request
description: The modelling handoff. A model is fitted either from an experiment record (the oil routes, and a grease round that imported one) or from a campaign round ledger (the grease route's own carrier, which is what a round boundary actually has). The applicability boundary travels WITH the model from P-2 (2026-10-14): the region the model was fitted on is the region it may predict in, so it is persisted here at the moment it is judged instead of being dropped and re-typed at step 16.
$comment: P-2 (2026-10-14): this file was previously closed against these keys -- two scripts recorded that the batch-3 scope did not permit changing it. The constraint was lifted by decision, and both scripts now say so; experiment_reference moved out of `required` into an anyOf so the grease route's campaign-driven round can build a model at all.

applicability_boundary.description: The region the model was fitted on, and therefore the only region it may predict in. Persisted when the modelling step judges it, so step 16 reads the recorded boundary instead of asking for it a second time.
